name: – Vlad Vasile-Voiculescu – § 35 – Am 20
title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text: 35. Calls on the Member States, in cooperation with relevant stakeholders, to increase efforts to provide more consumer information about the nutritional contents of various food products and the importance of healthy diets, especially among young people; stresses that to be effective, prevention of cancer must start during childhood and recognise the primary role of parents and families in fostering healthy and balanced dietary habits from an early age; calls on the Member States to promote healthy dietary habits from an early age, including in schools, sports facilities and recreational areas, with particular emphasis on access to fresh, local and seasonal products;
